name: Can I hire a general contractor just to replace plumbing fixtures?

mainEntity.name: Can I hire a general contractor just to replace plumbing fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing fixture replacement is included as a core part of bathroom and kitchen remodels or complete whole-home renovation projects. In full remodel scopes, fixtures such as faucets, showerheads, bathtubs, and sinks are updated alongside surrounding finishes like custom tile, vanities, or countertops. Standalone, single-fixture repair calls are typically better served by a service plumber, whereas a general contractor handles fixtures when integrated into larger construction, layout redesigns, or comprehensive surface upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: General contractors install plumbing fixtures as part of larger remodeling projects, such as kitchen, bathroom, or whole-house renovations, rather than as standalone handyman service calls.
